checks.rule: Time Stamped DTM is an archive of Environment Agency raster elevation surveys across England.
Site-specific LIDAR surveys have been carried out since 1998 and some areas have repeat surveys.
Available DTM resolutions include 25 cm, 50 cm, 1 m and 2 m depending on project requirements.
The DTM removes surface objects from DSM data using algorithms and manual editing to represent terrain.
Time-stamped DTM is distributed as GeoTIFF rasters in 5 km zip files.
Elevation values are metres referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn and aligned to the OS Grid.
Environment Agency states LIDAR vertical accuracy of plus or minus 15 cm RMSE.
The transformation used is specific to the survey time period.
Metadata index catalogues identify survey date, resolution, transformation and geoidal model for a location.
Never mix two survey epochs for a parcel without recording which epoch supplied each sample.
Prefer the highest appropriate available resolution only after confirming the exact survey tile and date.
Reject elevation promotion when transformation or geoidal-model provenance is missing from the selected survey metadata.
